# BAD-033 — Share one 'extract a run: | step out of a workflow' helper between the two tests that do it

## Brief
test/release-workflow.test.js and the new test/server/deploy-step.test.mjs each carry their own YAML line-slicer for a workflow step's shell body. They are near-identical and already differ in tolerance (release-workflow scans forward for the run: | line and stops at the next step; deploy-step requires it on the very next line), so a third test that wants one will copy whichever it finds first. A shared test helper would make the strictness a decision rather than an accident.

Evidence: test/release-workflow.test.js:29-46 stepScript(name); test/server/deploy-step.test.mjs:55-69 stepScript(workflow). Both read a workflow, find '- name: <step>', compute indent+2 and slice until the indentation drops.
